text:
leah: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need a one-line public blurb, a 72h customer summary, and a policy for who gets the full RCA. Can we lock owners now?

omar: I can draft the public blurb. Short + apology + promise to follow up in 72h.

tara: I'll own the 72h customer note (timeline, measured impact, recurrence analysis, and proposed runbook changes).

legal: We'll own the redaction rules. Nothing that contains PII, internal hostnames, or customer IDs goes out without sign-off/NDA.

support-lead: I'll produce the impacted-customer list and tag outreach owners; we should proactively notify Dedicated customers.

leah: OK, action items  react with :thumbsup: to accept or comment.

```
AI-701: Omar 97 Draft public status blurb by tomorrow 13:00 UTC and put in Statuspage draft.
AI-702: Tara 97 Publish 72h customer summary skeleton to PM-612 by 72h with metrics and recurrence plan.
AI-703: Legal 97 Deliver redaction checklist + approval flow by Fri EOD.
AI-704: Support-Lead 97 Share impacted customer list + outreach owners by EOD today.
AI-705: Leah 97 Add AIs to the incident ticket, set due dates, confirm final approver for public copy.
```

support-lead: Accept AI-704  tagging owners now.

omar: Accept AI-701. Draft here: "We experienced intermittent API errors between 03:10	6:05 UTC due to a database failover. Normal service resumed at 04:05 UTC after traffic rerouting. We apologize for the disruption and will publish a follow-up summary within 72 hours."

tara: Looks good. For the 72h doc I'll include a short section on the recurring failover pattern and two suggested runbook changes.

legal: We'll remove hostnames, internal IPs, and request-specific logs from the external summary. Full RCA available on request; Legal will advise on NDA scope.

ops-bot: Reminder: add AI-701..AI-705 to PM-612 with due dates.

leah: Thanks. If anyone needs to change an ETA, update this thread so we can reassign.

omar: Posting draft to Statuspage draft in 30m.

support-lead: Impacted customer list uploaded to PM-612 and owners assigned.

tara: Starting the 72h skeleton now, will ping when uploaded.

leah: Closing loop: I'll check PM-612 tomorrow and confirm approvals. If we see fresh recurrence signals, call them out here immediately.

omar: :thumbsup:
